profile.headline: Partner Support Manager
profile.summary:
I am a technology Jack-of-all-trades, with experience in computer programming, server administration, networking, and PC hardware, software and peripheral support, with a background in business management and organizational leadership.

I obtained my Bachelors of Business Administration from UW-Oshkosh, with a focus in Management Information Systems (MIS), along with a strong background in Human Resource Management and Legal Studies.

Along with my formal education, I have obtained certifications as a Microsoft Certified Applications Developer (MCAD.NET VB & C#), a Professional Scrum Developer (PSD), and a CompTIA A+ PC technician, as well as having been previously certified as a Hewlett-Packard Accredited Platform Specialist.

I have over a decade of experience programming in C#, as well as familiarity with Visual Basic, C++, Java, HTML, JavaScript, jQuery, TSQL, ASP.NET, Silverlight, and a basic understanding of COBOL, Progress and PHP.

My specialties include programming in C#.NET, with a focus on MVC, ASP.NET and TSQL.

positions.title: Partner Support Manager
positions.locationName: Stevens Point, Wisconsin, United States · Hybrid
positions.description: I lead a small team of seasoned technical consultants as part of Skyward's Professional Services Department, which provides troubleshooting assistance, consulting, and training to third-parties seeking to integrate their applications with Skyward's products.

positions.title: Technical Consulting Manager
positions.locationName: Stevens Point, Wisconsin, United States · Hybrid
positions.description: I managed a small team of technical consultants that provide services for vendors and district customers seeking to exchange and receive data from Skyward's products through the use of web APIs and reporting services.

positions.title: Lead Software Engineer for Professional Services
positions.locationName: Stevens Point, Wisconsin, United States · Hybrid
positions.description: Lead a small team of specialized developers focused on DevOps and application development and support surrounding Skyward's APIs, working with vendors to develop customer-facing integrations for school districts.

positions.title: Lead Software Engineer for Research & Development
positions.description: Led a small team of software engineers tasked with managing in-house ERP and CMS application management, as well as customer-facing applications that interact with ERP and CMS systems. Responsible for the creation and maintenance of web application used to facilitate customer migration between legacy and new software versions.

positions.title: Lead Software Engineer for Professional Services
positions.description: Lead a small team of specialized DevOps oriented developers fulfilling the tasks of Database Administration, Server Administration, Source Control Management, Release Management, Specialized Development and API Management. This team supports the larger development teams, and provides customization training and support to third-party developers.

positions.title: Developer Trainer
positions.description:
- Developing and maintaining a formal training curriculum for newly hired developers
- Providing a training program for new hires along with specialized training for experienced programmers when necessary.
- Collaborate with other product owners, business analysts, and developers to ensure materials covered by provided training is up-to-date, and best meets programming and business needs.
- Assessing employee skill levels and providing input as to the programming strengths and weaknesses of new hires for proper placement onto a scrum team.
- Maintaining knowledge of the company's products and systems to provide training, and join teams as needed to complete necessary projects.
- Assessing educational needs, plan, and implement staff development activities as it relates to software development training.
- Reviewing code for various teams to ensure high quality products.
- Organizing various "boot camps" for employees when new development techniques or technology are introduced.
- Developing and maintaining the internal programming documentation, providing technical advice, and creating programming standards for developers to follow.
- Acting as a product owner for projects assigned to new employees, and coordinating all activities pertaining to intern developers.
- Serving as the product owner for development teams from local educational programs that are working on Capstone projects.
- Developing a REST API to be used by customer developers.
- Providing a training program for customer developers so that they may interface with our products.
- Serving as a backup database and server administrator for our company products in the absence of our primary administrators.

positions.title: Research & Development Programmer Analyst
positions.description:
- Worked with a large development team in a scrum environment to create a new system and framework that will be used on future products.
- Designed and maintained data warehousing software, a Silverlight-based software package used by customers to create reports; extracting and transforming data from a Progress database, and loading into a Microsoft SQL Server database.
- Acted as the primary programmer responsible for the company resource management software that contains the staff, customer, financial, and project information for the entire company.
- Performed month-end reporting based on information contained in the resource management software.
- Addressed service calls regarding programming changes to both the data warehousing software and the resource management system.
- Assisted other programmers in the development and design of the company resource management system and data warehousing product.

positions.title: Programmer/Developer & System Support
positions.description:
- Designed and developed in-house applications for training course scheduling and maintenance, as well as applications for maintaining access to the company testing portal.
- Performed needs analysis of in-house applications by communicating with application users on a daily basis.
- Assisted with the development of courseware used by candidates seeking Microsoft, EC-Council, and CompTIA certification.
- Maintained all IT Centers computer systems, including personal computer technical support, network and server support, and database and application maintenance.
- Adjusted Active Directory group policy to reflect the changing needs of IT Centers.

positions.title: IS Technical Services Professional, LTE
positions.description:
- Supplied first and second level technical support to staff working for the WI Veterans Home at King, including preventive and corrective maintenance on campus personal computers, software and peripherals.
- Maintained detailed records of technology issues arising using the departmental Help Desk system.
- Supplied one-on-one training to staff members using department resources.

positions.title: IS Technical Services Professional
positions.description:
- Worked as part of the Technical Support Group to carry out preventive and corrective maintenance on, and setup computers, software, and peripherals, while maintaining an outstanding level of customer service.
- Aided University faculty and staff with issues arising from computer hardware and software, and advised colleges and departments of the University on proper computer hardware and software upgrades.
- Provided first level support to faculty, staff, and students on the Academic Computing Help Desk, and maintained detailed records of technology related issues through the help desk computer system.
- Supervised student interns and furnished one-on-one training, while leading by example.
- Set severity levels on work tickets, handled staff paperwork, and managed time and scheduling for work tickets.

company.name: University of Wisconsin-Oshkosh, Department of Academic Computing

positions.title: United Students in Residence Halls President
positions.description:
United Students in Residence Halls (USRH) is the residence hall association and governing body of the residence halls at the University of Wisconsin Oshkosh (UWO).

The USRH President acts as the head liaison between the students and the Department of Residence Life. The USRH President, along with the USRH Treasurer, co-chairs the campus Budget & Facilities Committee, which serves as an allocation committee that purchases items and upgrades for the residence halls.

The USRH President also chairs monthly President's Council meetings which is a committee comprised of the presidents of the individual residence halls, and serves, along with the USRH Vice President, as one of the six voting members of the All Campus Executive Board.

positions.title: Lead Student Network Technician
positions.description:
- Networked computers throughout the school district for intercommunication purposes, while leading a team of students to maintain the district network.
- Collaborated with faculty and staff in regards to network and internet connections throughout the district.

volunteerExperiences.companyName: IT Software Developer Apprenticeship Advisory Committee
volunteerExperiences.description: As part of the IT Developer Apprenticeship Council, I worked with the Department of Workforce Development (DWD), Bureau of Apprenticeship Standards (BAS), Mid-State Technical College (MSTC), and other industry specialists to develop a new IT Software Developer Apprenticeship for the State of Wisconsin.  Personally, I worked closely with the IT instructors at MSTC to develop the curriculum necessary for the new IT Software Developer Apprenticeship curriculum.

company.name: IT Software Developer Apprenticeship Advisory Committee

volunteerExperiences.companyName: Mid-State Technical College IT Advisory Committee
volunteerExperiences.description: As part of the IT Advisory Committee for Mid-State Technical College, I assist educators in formulating program goals, activities, and objectives.  We assess labor market standards and trends, as well as define the job competencies required for the IT program's target jobs.  The committee advises faculty in relating instruction to the current needs of employers in the IT industry, and assesses the adequacy and appropriateness of facilities, equipment, and resource materials.  The committee also reviews the program's assessment data, as well as assists in acquiring gifts and grants for the public, and advises on public information campaigns.

company.name: Mid-State Technical College IT Advisory Committee
